current_prompt.body:
READ the undirected graph G with 12 nodes (0 through 11) from the provided edge list
DETERMINE whether a Hamiltonian path exists that visits each node exactly once
IF a Hamiltonian path exists THEN
    OUTPUT the complete sequence of node identifiers
    VERIFY that the path visits all 12 nodes
    VERIFY that each consecutive pair in the path corresponds to an edge in the graph
ENDIF

current_plan.body:
READ the edge list to construct graph G with 12 nodes
DETERMINE whether a Hamiltonian path exists on G using a backtracking search with pruning
IF a Hamiltonian path exists THEN
    OUTPUT the sequence of node identifiers
    VERIFY that the sequence visits all 12 nodes
    VERIFY that each consecutive pair in the sequence corresponds to an edge in G
ENDIF
